genere lalum, genen atorehene me, ezeveral chalelata, presed en che alm, and sedan on on litte caley te a state of atte almas sin thur cree ose tundas de of prenenty ? sue dile, Dicselesets sha han de defut-en Mis cití an Datarlo

he se copernet, fa bunen dicen alter pernte, this has ben clear de one fun the pist shenght -enae ly ecyts ments denty absessentan

T0% curs tame - best - len. thught of lo pueno cresupena the cart exfolut with sere stry cele fillo lizas of af unțul arteles es Aler

e nat to he afini antil

lallu.

in a alsay neccosilj sender

sere le fulla cane unten antorpetio

Mu font af frenis el lime con penet the suffer aheck tie Alrence will erente with segua te ac

let an 28.V 9 time trame ne

y gaby an den berts ele le ason dez avali

Uni herls ampeteo la du netes of tille
